exposure: Ultrasound-guided high intensity focused ultrasound (USgHIFU) for uterine fibroids
outcome: Efficacy of USgHIFU for symptom relief
cohort: 12 patients with symptomatic uterine fibroids who underwent USgHIFU
finding: This study demonstrates the clinical efficacy of USgHIFU ablation of uterine fibroids and the low risk of complications in an NHS population.
mod_finding: The study mentions a patient who experienced a second-degree skin burn during treatment due to a surgical scar from a previous caesarean section, but the study does not focus on mode of delivery.
